credits.title: Last Signal
credits.overview: After a sinkhole accident, signs emerge that a building is on the verge of collapse. Ha-young, a temporary public servant, tries to warn the public, but her superiors refuse to act. As the danger grows, four young people connected to the building in different ways begin to uncover the corruption surrounding it.

credits.title: Number One
credits.overview: Eighteen-year-old Ha-min suddenly begins to see the number "365" every time he eats his mother's homemade meal—and the number drops with each bite. credits.title: Christmas Carol
credits.overview: On a Christmas Eve, a lifeless body of teenage boy is found. The victim's revenge-driven twin brother checks himself into a juvie to hunt down the suspects.
